description: This file defines utility functions for UI components in a Java Swing application. The class UiUtils provides methods for saving images, updating button text, centering windows, repainting components, setting tooltips, wrapping components in panels, creating buttons, loading icons, invoking code on the Swing event dispatch thread, and displaying loading messages.

classes.name: UiUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for common UI operations within the application.

methods.name: saveImageWithPrompt
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a file location and saves the provided component as a PNG image.

methods.name: getFileChooser
methods.description: Creates and returns a JFileChooser configured with the specified file filter.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves a screenshot of the specified component to the given filename.

methods.name: setPauseButtonText
methods.description: Updates the text on a pause/resume button based on the pause state.

methods.name: centerWindow
methods.description: Centers a window on the screen.

methods.name: trueRepaint
methods.description: Performs a repaint of a JComponent or Container, refreshing its display.

methods.name: trueLayout
methods.description: Invalidates, validates, and repaints a component to force layout refresh.

methods.name: setTwoLineToolTip
methods.description: Sets an HTML tooltip with two lines of text on a component.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a JComponent inside a JPanel.

methods.name: createSaveImageButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton configured for saving images.

methods.name: loadIcon
methods.description: Loads an ImageIcon from a resource path.

methods.name: invokeAndWait
methods.description: Executes a Runnable on the Event Dispatch Thread, waiting for completion.

methods.name: showLoadingMessage
methods.description: Adds a 'Loading...' label to a given JPanel.

methods.name: createPauseButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton for pausing/resuming with appropriate mnemonic.

methods.name: createClearButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton for clearing with appropriate mnemonic.
